text.en:
Paragraph (c), subsection A of section one of Act Numbered Forty hundred and fifty-nine, is
hereby amended so that item eleven, on page thirty-three, under the caption "Nueva Ecija" shall read as
"11. For the construction of the Aliaga Elementary School .............. P2,000.00"

Paragraph (c), subsection A of section one of Act Numbered Forty hundred and fifty-nine, is
hereby amended so that item sixty on page nineteen under the caption "Cebu" shall read as follows:
"60. For the construction of the Elementary School of Bunacan, Madridejos P2,000.00"

Paragraph (i), subsection B of section one of Act Numbered Forty hundred and fifty-nine, is
hereby amended so that item two on page sixty-three under the caption "Marinduque" shall read as follows:
"2. For the construction of the Libtangin Spillway ........................... P3,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, November 8, 1933.
